answer: A signal of equivocation is checked against a mirror of bonded-escrow histories, while a sable audit record links identities acting in concert. For k coordinated identities, correlated equivocation triggers penalties scaling as O(k^2), not merely k separate fines. Detection can compound forfeiture and asymmetric collateral depreciation, so controlling a sybil swarm exposes its operator to an exponential multiplier in total capital loss.
